en.用视觉与运动感知，了解身体的每一次变化。: Understand your movement with vision and motion sensing.
en.自动校正：请短暂站直，双手自然下垂。: Stand upright briefly with your arms relaxed to align the view.
en.检查 USB 连接后，点击「重连摄像头」。: Check the USB cable, then select Reconnect camera.
en.请确保全身入画，完成一次动作后显示反馈。: Keep your whole body in view. Feedback appears after a complete rep.
en.规则分数不代表模型置信度；阈值仍需真实动作校准。: Rule-based score, not model confidence. Thresholds still need real exercise validation.
en.位置来自机体系加速度双积分，运动时会漂移；Yaw 无磁力计约束。该视图用于原型观: Position is double-integrated from body-frame acceleration and drifts during movement. Yaw has no magnetometer reference. This is a prototype view, not precise positioning.
en.尚无 IMU 样本。可连接 S3，或在配置页明确选择历史 CSV 回放。: No IMU samples yet. Connect S3 or explicitly select historical CSV replay in Devices & Calibration.
en.沿用原 Windows 应用的零偏 Profile、静止检测、互补滤波和 ZUP: Uses the original bias profile, stationary detection, complementary filter and ZUPT. Pale green marks stationary intervals.
en.默认不复位，避免中断无线报警转发。勾选后会短暂重启 S3。: Reset is off by default to preserve radio forwarding. Enabling it briefly restarts S3.
en.回放只影响 IMU 视图；视觉检测仍独立运行。回放数据不会伪装成实时数据。: Replay affects only the IMU views. Vision runs independently. Historical data is always labeled.
en.沿用原校准门槛与参数校验。配置在本次应用会话内生效，请导出保存；不会覆盖仓库中的: Uses the original validation gates. Changes apply to this session only; export to save. The repository profile is preserved.
en.视觉与 IMU 独立采集，报警协议保持解耦。: Independent vision and IMU. A decoupled alarm module.

en.双脚略宽于髋部，脚尖自然外展，保持整个脚掌稳定着地。: Stand slightly wider than hip-width, toes gently turned out, with your whole foot grounded.
en.收紧核心，髋部向后下方移动，膝盖与脚尖方向一致。: Brace your core, move your hips back and down, and keep your knees tracking with your toes.
en.在可控范围内下蹲，避免脚跟抬起或背部弯曲，再平稳站起。: Lower only as far as you can control without lifting your heels or rounding your back, then stand smoothly.
en.双手约与肩同宽，肩膀位于手掌上方，保持头部与躯干对齐。: Set your hands about shoulder-width apart, shoulders over your palms, and align your head with your torso.
en.收紧核心与臀部，控制身体整体下降，避免塌腰或抬高臀部。: Brace your core and glutes. Lower your body as one unit without sagging or raising your hips.
en.胸部接近地面后平稳推起，让肩、髋与腿部同步移动。: As your chest approaches the floor, press up smoothly with shoulders, hips and legs moving together.
en.站稳并收紧核心，向前迈步时避免躯干左右晃动。: Stand steady and brace your core. Avoid swaying your torso as you step forward.
en.前脚踩稳后让髋部下沉，前膝与脚尖方向一致，背部保持平直。: Plant your front foot, lower your hips, track your front knee with your toes, and keep your back neutral.
en.在舒适且可控的幅度内下降，再用前脚发力回到起始站姿。: Lower within a comfortable, controlled range, then push through your front foot to return to standing.
